note: Where the study facts come from. after_undergrad (master's) is set in ALL-professions.json and abroad in abroad.json; this file says what backs each value. checked = an official rule, cited (usually through education-press reporting of the notice); supported = published evidence that is not a rule; judgement = no source, Claude's judgement. A career not listed here is judgement. The monthly study bot re-checks the oldest rows and the admin approves any change.

ugc_phd.title: UGC PhD Regulations 2022 — PhD needs a master's (55%) or a 4-year degree with 75% / CGPA 7.5

ugc_teach.title: UGC Minimum Qualifications Regulations 2018 — Assistant Professor needs a master's with 55% plus NET/SET or a PhD

csir_net.title: CSIR-UGC NET eligibility — M.Sc with 55%, or a 4-year BS / B.Tech / B.Pharm with 75%

rci.title: Clinical psychology training and accreditation in India — RCI registration needs an RCI-recognised clinical qualification (M.Phil, now the RCI-regulated MA in Clinical Psychology from 2025–26)

gsi.title: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist exam (Geological Survey of India, CGWB) — a master's in geology or a listed geoscience

ies_iss.title: UPSC IES/ISS — IES needs a postgraduate degree in economics; ISS accepts a bachelor's or master's with statistics

dcpu.title: Mission Vatsalya — District Child Protection Unit posts need a postgraduate degree in social work, sociology, psychology, law or a related field

library.title: UGC norms for college librarians — a master's in library science with 55% plus NET

asi.title: Archaeological Survey of India — Assistant Archaeologist needs a master's in archaeology, ancient Indian history, anthropology or geology

ansi.title: Anthropological Survey of India — Anthropologist posts need a master's in anthropology plus research experience

museum.title: National Museum — curator posts need a master's in museology, history of art, history, archaeology or a related subject

nmi.title: National Museum Institute — MA Museology and MA Conservation, the specialised training for museum and conservation work

cpcb.title: Central Pollution Control Board — Scientist B needs a first-class master's in environmental science (or a B.E./B.Tech in an environmental branch)

icar.title: ICAR — entry-level ARS scientists need a master's in the relevant agricultural discipline

fsl.title: State Forensic Science Laboratory recruitment (Telangana) — Scientific Officer needs an M.Sc in forensic science or the relevant science

mph.title: Career opportunities for MPH graduates in India (published study) — public-health roles commonly hire at MPH level

msw.title: Government social-sector posts (Mission Vatsalya) list a postgraduate degree in social work among the required qualifications

dgca.title: Converting a foreign CPL to an Indian licence — DGCA exams, an Indian Class 1 medical, RTR(A) and a flight test

jest.title: JEST — the Indian entrance to PhD programmes in physics and astronomy at IISc, TIFR, IUCAA, RRI and 30-odd institutes
